prize_pod_routes.instructions: Spawn point on top of a waterfall near the exit to the Courtyard. If four Red Hot Chilis appear leave the area and return.
Lit area far on the right. Defeat the Monotruckers and Red Hot Chilis. If four Scrappers appear leave the area and return.
Area to the left of the path from the Courtyard.
In-between the wall of fire and the two Scrappers (and sometimes one Bruiser) at the northernmost part.
Columned area to the left of the entrance. If Red Hot Chilis appear, leave the area and return.
After exiting the Forest Clearing, in the corner of the cliff on the left side.
Go over to the fountain in the center and defeat four Red Hot Chilis. If another four appear, exit the area and come back.
Far end of the area next to the candle, accessible through the hole on top of the end table with a clock in the Wardrobe Room. Reenter until it appears.
Underneath the stairs on the left side. If you don't encounter a single Bruiser beforehand, reenter the area until it appears.
Defeat four Blue Sea Salts in the recess adjacent to the stairs. If Red Hot Chilis appear instead, leave the area and come back.
Defeat four Blue Sea Salts in the blue walled roof across from the exit to Pete's Rec Room, only accessible via Air Sliding. If a Chrono Twister appears, leave the area and come back.
Roof leading from the exit to Pete's Rec Room. Defeat four Blue Sea Salts. If none appear, leave the area and come back.
After exiting the Raceway Registration, immediately to your left against the wall with the hidden Mickeys. Must defeat a few Blue Sea Salts beforehand.
Southeast corner. If only Red Hot Chilis appear, or none appear at all, leave the area and come back until Red Hot Chilis and Prize Pods appear together.
Far end of the area.
In the airlock leading to the Ship Exterior. Defeat the first wave of enemies that appear in the room, after which the Prize Pods will appear. If Sonic Blasters appear, leave the area and come back.
Far end of the hall.
Small cliff accessible via Air Slide from Skull Rock: Cavern. If Jellyshades and a Triple Wrecker appear, leave the area and come back.

On the ledge accessible from the Cliff Path. A Wild Bruiser will appear alone first, followed by the Prize Pods and four Yellow Mustards. If the Wild Bruiser and Yellow Mustards appear together, exit the area and re-enter.
At the far north cliff-edge on the patch of green grass. Appears alongside a Wild Bruiser. If it doesn't appear, leave and re-enter the area.
The Prize Pods appear in the second-to-last wave of Round Three.
Clear Round One and Round Two, and the first two waves of Round Three; the Prize Pods will appear on both floors.

prize_pod_reset: If the prerequisite encounter produces the wrong enemies, leave the room and re-enter. After Prize Pods appear, leave the world for the Lanes Between before trying again. Pods flee after 30 seconds and release flavors per hit.

boss_encounters.name: Vanitas Remnant
boss_encounters.access: Clear Final Episode, then examine the emblem in Badlands on a main-character save.
boss_encounters.instructions: D-Links are unavailable. Cure-family magic causes the boss to heal; use healing items or healing finish/defense abilities instead. Mines can punish close approaches; Ventus can use Tornado and Aqua Seeker Mine. Evade during the boss’s protected attacks. Retry does not necessarily restore spent items; the source distinguishes Retry from Continue.

boss_encounters.name: Unknown
boss_encounters.access: Defeat Vanitas Remnant; return on a main save with Land of Departure accessible.
boss_encounters.instructions: Use short Thunder Surge openings and retreat before healing. Treasure Magnet helps recover scattered deck commands. Renewal Barrier punishes prolonged attacks; clones disappear when struck. In Final Mix, Air Slide can escape Collision Magnet before its follow-up. D-Link use can trigger early invisibility. Leave and return to repeat the fight.

boss_encounters.name: Armor of Eraqus
boss_encounters.instructions: The HD encounter has 1,000 HP (the PSP value is 1,200). Striking the protected back can stun the attacker. Favor openings created by blocking/countering; reflected attacks, mines, surges and Shotlocks provide alternatives to long exposed combos.

boss_encounters.name: No Heart
boss_encounters.instructions: Attack the floating No Name Keyblade to remove the opening barrier, then fight No Heart directly. Keep healing windows between attacks; its large area attack can drain HP, commands and Focus. HD Shotlocks can damage No Heart; do not import PSP immunity assumptions.

boss_encounters.name: Monstro
boss_encounters.instructions: Defeat stomach Unversed to reach the exterior. The exterior normally has a three-minute limit; timeout returns you to the stomach with less safe floor, while the fourth exterior round has no timer. Hit the idling whale with two explosive barrels to stun it, then attack its tongue or use a Shotlock. HD HP is 1,500 rather than PSP 1,800.

boss_encounters.name: Dark Hide
boss_encounters.access: Reach the end of the separate Secret Episode.
boss_encounters.instructions: This boss is a Heartless. Barrier and Counter Blast answer the opening charging attacks; watch for teleports behind Aqua. Ignite and ranged attacks can create damage opportunities. Later afterimages make direction harder to read; heal between attack sequences.

fruitball.rules: Score more goals in three minutes; ties enter sudden death. Bump fruit upward, then use the prompted smash. Split grapes create five scoring balls; banana peels stun, and pineapples ricochet. Avoid leaving fruit unattended for five seconds.

racing_followup.edition: International / Final Mix; five-lap Arena goals retained, original Japanese three/nine-lap variants excluded.
racing_followup.rules: Accelerate through dash rings; brake for corners. Guard when DANGER warns of an attack. Shields permit passage through tornadoes; unshielded contact loses time.

Country Chase.route: Use the ramp after the first turn; after rejoining, keep near the wall to avoid the paired tornadoes.

Disney Drive.route: Take the town ramp and dash ring. At the narrow tornado path keep right or use a shield; turn sharply after the next shortcut.

Grand Spree.route: This reverses most of Disney Drive. Use town ramps to reach the shield ledge; watch the tornado after the dirt-road shortcut.

Castle Circuit.route: In the courtyard turn left and jump into the fenced hole for the short route. Underground, the right ledge is safer; a sharp left offers the riskier shortcut.

command_boards.rules: Menu play awards purchased opponent commands at game end. Limited bonus rewards appear only while absent from the current command list; selling all copies can restore them. Arena uses its separate reward column. A dash is the source’s absent reward, not an unknown value. Panel keys refer to the linked board map; they are not Reports order.
